༄༅/ /dag yig nye mkho bsdus pa shākya'i dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dag yig nye mkho bsdus pa shākya'i dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /

na mo gu ru/ dag yig nyer mkho bsdus pa bzhugs zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'dir nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge 'di'i ming 'di zhes bya zhing*/ don 'di brjod pa la tshig 'di dang 'di 'jug go zhes bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir bstan bcos 'di rtsom mo/ / de la bstan bcos 'di'i sdom tshig ni/ spyir bstan grangs nges tshig phrad dang*/ / 'phul dang brten pa'i spang blang dang*/ / dmigs bsal so sor dbye ba ste/ / rnam pa lnga yis bsdus pa yin/ / zhes bya'o/ / de la dang po ni/ yi ge sum cu bu ni bzhi/ / ya btags bdun dang ra btags bcu/ / de bzhin 'og tu la btags drug / wa btags rnam pa bcu gnyis dang*/ / ra la btags pa bcu gsum dang*/ / la la btags pa bcu dang ni/ / sa la btags pa bcu gnyis dang*/ / 'phul yig lnga dang mtha' rten bcu/ / steng 'og yi ge mu bzhi ste/ / 'phul dang rten la mu gsum yin/ / zhes pa ni/ bstan bcos 'di'i brjod bya gtso che ba spyir bstan pa'o/ / da ni spyir bstan pa de dag rim pa bzhin du grangs nges pa'i tshul 'di dag yin no/ / zhes bshad par bya ste/ yi ge sum cu dper brjod ni/ / a pha kho ni ja chang sha / gcig pu za 'dzu de la he/ / nya wa tsho yi ti ka re/ / thob tsam zhus zhes bya ba yin/ / gu gu zhabs kyu na ro 'greng bu rnams ni bu bzhi ste/ yi ge kun la sbyar rung dper/ /tshig 'di yid kyis 'dris bgyi'i phyir/ / bu tshur myur du bzung du zungs/ / g.yel med bshes gnyen nyer bsten te/ / chos nor longs spyod yongs thob mdzod/ / ya btags bdun dang ra btags ni/ / bcu nyid bshad pa de dag dper/ / kye ma grogs khyod chang la dgyes/ / rtog dpyod phyogs bcur byed cing myos/ / bkra shis 'khrigs pa'i grwa sa 'dir/ / dra sgos spras pa'i 'phred sgo can/ / pho brang nang na smra mkhan bya/ / ske ba bsring nas hrig ge blta/ / la btags drug gi dper brjod ni/

/ ༈ kla klo glan pa blun po rnams/ / zla bo brlag go bya ba slob/ / wa btags bcu gnyis de yang dper/ / ༈ kwa yi khwa mkhon grwa pa 'di/ / lan grangs bco brgyad rtswa khu 'byugs/ / lan tshwa zos nas 'phrug zhwa gyon/ / zwa thug rwa gzar dag gis bcus/ / shwa chu bswag lam 'dzem med rgol/ / phu thung hwa gdod gos rnams gyon/ / ra la btags pa'i bcu yi dper/ / ༈ mthun rkyen rgyags chu rngam po che/ / rje yi srol rnying brten pa yi/ / mtsho chen rdol ba rnams kyi rba// rmangs na rtse mo'i rdzong zhes ni/ / rlung gis bskyod 'dra thob par 'gyur/ / la la btags pa bcu po yi dper/ / ༈ lkug pa 'di yi lgang gro lnga/ / lcug phran ljon pa'i ldang nas rnyed/ / bltas nas zos pa'i lpags pa des/ / lbos pa'i lhums dag bde bar 'gyur/ / ༈ sa la btags pa bcu gnyis ni/ / zas snyom bsgrims pa'i snga rol tu/ / snyan brgyud ster ba'i sdom brtson te/ / sna tshogs spel zhing sbyar ba yis/ / mdo dang smon lam bka' bstsal te/ / slad nas zas kyi bya ba byas/ / ga da ba ma 'a dang lnga/ / 'phul yig lnga yis 'phul ba na/ / ga yis 'phul ba bcu gnyis dper/ / ༈ gtan du gdan sar gnas pa'i tshe/ / lan grangs gcig dang gnyis min par/ / gtsug lag gzhung rnams blo la bzung*/ / g.yel med bde gshegs gsung rab bltas/ da yis 'phul ba drug gis dper/ / ༈ dkar po dge ba'i dngos grub tu/ / dpal 'byor dbang phyug mi dman thob/ / bas 'phul bcu yi dper brjod ni/ / ༈ bkra shis bgrang bas bcom ldan btud/ / bdug gis btsun tshugs tshul bzhin bzung*/ / sdig pa bshags nas dge ba bsags/ / ma yis 'phul ba bcu gcig dper/ / mkhas pa mgon po'i mngon sum du/ / mchi nas mjal bar mnyes gyur te/ / mtho ba'i mdun ma grub bam mngon/ / mtshan mo'i rmi ltas mdzes pa rmis/ / 'as 'phul bcu yi dper brjod ni/ / ༈'khun cing 'gul ba'i lus 'chang ste/ / 'ja' mo 'thad par 'dug ces te/

/ 'phyon ma 'bod par 'tshal nas 'dzud/ / ༈ ga nga da na ma ba 'a/ /ra la sa bcu mtha' rten te/ / phyogs tsam rim bzhin dper brjod na/ / ༈ bdag kyang khyed bzhin grub bsam dga'/ / myur du 'jal zhus lta bu ste/ / ༈ ka nas a yi bar dag la/ / phal cher 'jug ste skabs kyis shes/ / rkyang pa 'phul ba 'a mtha' dgos/ / brtsegs dang bu drug can la spang*/ / de phyir 'a ni mtha' rten phyed/ / 'i dang 'ang sogs tsheg bar min/ / steng 'og dag gi yi ge la/ / gnyis ka yin dang gnyis ka min/ / steng yig yin yang 'og yig ni/ / min zhes bya ba'i mu bzhi ste/ / rim pas ka kha sa ha bzhin/ / 'phul yig mtha' rten gnyis ka min/ / gnyis ka yin dang mtha' rten ni/ / yin yang 'phul yig min pa gsum/ / ka dang ga dang nga bzhin no/ / zhes pa ni grangs nges rgyas par bstan pa'o/ / da ni yi ge snga ma'i shugs kyis de'i rjes 'jug tu tshig 'di dang 'di 'jug go zhes ji ltar thob tshul rim pa bzhin bshad pa ni/ ༈ da ba sa kyi ga nga gi / na ma ra la gyi ste dper/ khyod kyi rkyab kyi ngos kyi cha| |bdag gi gdong gi ngos na mchis/ / mdun gyi rum gyi skor gyi ni/ / mngal gyi sgo de bdag la ston/ / 'a dang rkyang pa 'dogs can gyi/ / rjes su 'i 'thob tshig bcad kyi/ / yi ge ma tshang yi thob dper/ / rtse dga'i dga' bas bde ba'i mchog/ de sus myang ba dga' yi dpal/ / sa yi bdag po de yi gzhan/ / ga dang ba yi rjes su tu/ / nga da na ma ra la du/ / sa su 'a dang 'dogs can dang*/ / rkyang pa ru ste dpe rim bzhin/ / rtag tu rab tu 'byung du de/ / snod du rgyun du zhim du zo/ / myur du mjal du 'ong dus su/ / bza' ru yod pa'i gnas 'di ru/ kha ru zhim rgyu'i zas 'di byin/ / da de na ra la sa ste/ btud de bslan te byin pa yis/ / bskyar te 'thul te 'jigs te byung*/ / ga nga ba ma 'a rnams dang*/ / 'dogs can rkyang mthar sa ste ste/ / skrag ste gsang ste gnas pa yis/

/ thub ste 'dzum ste dga' ste gda'/ / bde ste sha chang za ste snang*/ / ga da ba sa'i rjes su'ang kyang*/ / skabs 'gar na yi rjes su'ang kyang*/ / bdag kyang 'bad kyang 'brel med pa'i/ / bya ba thob kyang des kyang ci/ / 'on kyang 'phral gyi 'tsho ba 'byung*/ / nga 'a na ma ra la yang*/ / yang yang skyes bu 'ga' yang ni/ / byon yang nam yang ma phrad de/ / slar yang mjal yang spyan ma drangs/ / 'dogs can rkyang mthar phal cher 'ang*/ / tshig rkang ma tshang yang ste dper/ / ci yang yod pa'i phyug po yang*/ / de 'dra bdag la 'byung du yang re/ / ga da ba cing sa mthar shing*/ / phyug cing blun pa rgud cing 'gro/ / slob cing nus pa mkhas shing phyug/ nga 'a na ma ra la dang*/ / 'dogs can rkyang pa rnams zhing dper/ / drang zhing bde ba rab dga' zhing*/ / snyan zhing 'gyur ba 'jam zhing mdzes/ / dar zhing rgyas par 'tshal zhing bdag / bde zhing skyid nas za zhing snang*/ / ga da ba ces nga 'a dang*/ / na ma ra la sa dang ni/ / 'dogs can rkyang pa zhes te dper/ / rtag ces bya ba'i bdag yod ces/ / smra ba zab ces byung zhes thob/ / gda' zhes 'di lta yin zhes pa'am/ / 'di tsam zhes pa 'gyur zhes par/ / 'khrul zhes ston pas legs gsungs zhes/ / mi mkhas pa zhes smra zhes bshad/ kha cig sa mthar shes zhes zer/ / mi 'thad par mthong kho bos 'dor/ / ga da ba cig sa mthar shig/ rkyang pa'i rjes su yin te dper/ / shog cig sod cig rgyob cig ces/ / gyis shig ces ni kha cig smra/ / nga 'a na ma ra la dang*/ / 'dogs can rnams kyi mthar zhig dper/ / cung zhig sdod la 'ga' zhig la/ / 'phrin zhig nam zhig bskur zhig ces/ / dal zhig gsos la mdo zhig smros/ / na ra la gsum rjes su ni/ / sgra bsgyur snga mas da drag bzhed/ / de tshe cing ces cig 'thob kyang*/ / phyi ma rnams kyis da drag dor/ / 'on kyang na ra la gsum gyi/ / rjes su zhig zhes zhig yin na'ang*/ / da drag nges thob pa der/ / da drag sbyor ram mi sbyor yang*/

/ cing ces cig ces zhes te dper/ / mkhas par mkhyen cing yon tan gyis/ / brgyan ces thob kyi ston cig ces/ / zer cing mthong nas mtshar ces te// bdag kyang 'di drar gyur cig ces/ / smon lam btsal cing slob par ni/ / 'tshal ces zer gyis myur rtsol cig/ ga da ba mthar ce na dang*/ / sa mthar she na sbyar te dper/ / su 'dug ce na bla ma bzhugs// ci 'chad ce na gdams pa ste/ / gang zab ce na spros bral chos/ / sus thos shes na bdag gis thos/ / nga 'a na ma ra la dang*/ / 'dogs can rkyang pa zhe na dper/ / gang byung zhe na hor 'dra ste/ / du gda' zhe na mang po'o/ / su yin zhe na dben pa ste/ khrims kyis dben nam zhe na dben/ / ci skor zhe na rgyal khams te/ / gang btsal zhe na nom pa'o/ / ci skyes zhe na bu skyes te/ / su la zhe na smad tshong la'o/ / ga da ba sa na ma ni/ / zag pa med pa'i bya ba ni/ / thob pa nyes pa las grol nas/ / 'gro la phan pa'i bsam pas gnas/ / nga 'a ra la 'dogs can dang*/ / rkyang pa'i rjes su ba phyed war/ / 'bod pa rnams la ba sbyar zhing*/ / gzhan la pa nyid sbyar te dper/ / btung ba dga' ba myur bar 'thung*/ / mjal ba zhi ba tsha bar 'dod/ / lung pa mda' pa 'byor pa che/ / yul pa phub pa bya ba mang*/ / dri ba'i dgag tshig skabs su ni/ / mtha' rten rnams la ma sbyar zhing*/ / skabs 'gar ra la tam dang ni/ / 'dogs can rkyang pa 'am ste dper/ / 'dug gam byung ngam yod dam dang*/ / yin nam grub bam sgom mam dang*/ / gda' 'am 'gyur ram 'tshal lam dang*/ / shes sam zer tam go 'am dang*/ / ba 'am shes pa lta bu'o/ / rdzogs tshig skabs su na ra gnyis/ / ma gtogs mtha' rten brgyad po la/ / rang la na ro sbyar te dper/ khyod ni phyug po gshis bzang ngo*/ / gtong yang phod do chos grub bo/ / 'khor yang 'dzom mo bzhugs gda'o/ / thugs kyang dal lo zhes thos so/ / na ra gnyis la na ro dang*/ / to zhes rnam gnyis su 'gyur dper/ / bzhin ni zhes ni rab bstan to/

/ ngo mtshar ro zhes gzhan zer to/ / rkyang pa 'dogs can 'o ste dper/ / sha ni za'o skyid de'o/ / de rnams phal cher nyis shad dang*/ / le'u'i mtshams sogs bzhi shad 'thob/ / rkyang shad dang ni tshig shad dag / thob tshul skabs dang sbyar la dpyad/ / ga yi rjes su chig shad dang*/ / shad gang phal cher phyi tsheg spang*/ / zhes pa ni tshig phrad rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / / / da ni phul yig dang mtha' rten sbyar du rung ba dang*/ mi rung ba rnam par dbye ba bstan pa'i phyir smras pa/ tshogs pas chos gsum byon pa ni/ / phal pa'i chang gis bzi ba yi/ / phun tshogs 'phrin las rim gro pa/ / sku khams khros dang khro ba dang*/ / phra ma 'khon 'dzin can dang 'phrad/ / phra la phrag par phyung ba yi/ / phreng bas tshon gyi kha bsgyur ba/ / phra mo phal cher khron par lhung*/ / thur du babs te phyin pa yis/ / phran tshegs tsam las ma rnyed pham/ / skad cig thang cig yud tsam cig/ shog cig sdod cig kha cig zer/ / zhes sogs rnams la 'phul yig spang*/ lha btsun bza' btung med pa dang*/ / che btsun na bza' hrul ba dang*/ / lha rje nga rgyal che ba dang*/ / bya rgod rdo rje bcom pa rnams/ / me tog rgya mtshor lhung ba 'dra/ / zhes sogs mtha' rten med phyir spang*/ / bdud rtsi thugs rje byang chub sogs/ / mtha' rten med kyang nor bas spang*/ / lha rdzas rgya cher yongs 'thor te/ / myang 'das thob pa'i rgyur gyur nas/ / phar phyin rdzogs te nyer zhi zhing*/ / dbyer med sogs la mtha' rten ni/ / lhug pa'i tshe na mi 'thob kyang*/ / tshigs bcad sdeb sbyor dgos pa'ang yod/ / ting nge 'dzin dang 'gyur ro dang*/ / gzhon nus chung ngu nyung du sogs/ / phyi ma'i tshig gis shugs dag gis/ / cung zad phan pas nges par sbyor/ / zhes pa ni 'phul yig dang mtha' rten rnam par phye nas bstan pa'o/ / da ni 'dir don 'dra ba gcig nyid la yang tshig brjod tshul mi 'dra ba du mas nor bar bri ba dang*/ 'khrul bar klog par mang mthong zhing*/

don mi 'dra ba du ma yang tshig mi 'dra ba gcig nyid kyis 'bri zhing klog pa yang mthong bas/ de dag bsal ba'i phyir tshig 'di ni don 'di brjod pa la 'jug la/ don 'di brjod pa la mi 'jug go / zhes khyad par rnam par phye bas bstan pa'i phyir/ dmigs kyis bsal te smras pa/ ra rka da dka' sa ska rnams/ / chu lam mi nus lce yi yul/ / ba 'og bka' ni rgyal ba'i gsungs/ / ra rgo sa sgo ba bgo rnams/ / ri dwags sgo bsrungs gos gyon te/ / ba 'og sa bsgo bka' bsgo'o/ / la lkal sa skal ba sa'i bskal/ / med dang thob dang dus yin no/ / ra rga sa sga da dga' rnams/ / na tshod rta sga yid dga' ste/ / la la lga btags sman gyi ming*/ / sa snga la lnga ra rnga rnams// dus dang grangs dang brdung bya ste/ / ma 'og mnga' ni zhe sa'o/ / nye ngu'i gnyen ni gsang 'phul te/ / reg bya mnyen pa mas 'phul lo/ / ba 'og sa bsnyen drung du btud/ / sa bdag gnyan ni gas 'phul lo/ / rna bar snyan pa sa snyan yin/ / chos mnyan ma yis nya 'phul te/ / ba 'og ra brnyan gzugs brnyan no/ / ga gtar nyid ni khrag 'byin pa/ / ba 'og sa bstar chas gzab po/ / tar lab rgyus pa tar rkyang yin/ / ga gtan sa stan ba sa'i bstan/ / rgyun du bting bya gzhan bstan te/ / ba 'og ra brtan mi 'gyur ba/ / ga 'og gda' dang ba 'og bda'/ / zhes sa dang ni zas skom zhim/ / ba 'og ra brda lag brda yin/ / ba bdug ga gdug sa sdug rnams/ / spos dag sbrul dang mdzes nyon mongs/ / ga gcin sa la pa btags spyin/ / mi gtsang ba dang 'byar byed do/ / das 'phul dpyad dang sa btags spyad/ / shes pa'i yul dang longs spyod do/ / bas 'phul bcad pa dum bur ro/ / ra rba sa sba la lba rnams/ / chu rtag mi mngon 'gul pa'i rgyan/ / mig dang rmig rwa rmig pa rnams/ / dbang po bu ga dud 'gro lham/ / das 'phul dgra dang sa btags sgra/ / gnod pa byed dang rna ba'i yul/ / 'bubs sbra sa la ba btags so/ / tshal dang 'a yis 'phul ba'i 'tshal/

/ nags tshal dang ni zhe sa ste/ / sman gyi mtshal ni ma yis 'phul/ / sa sbags mi mngon gab pa ste/ / la lkugs lce yis smra mi shes/ / chang ni myos byed btung bya ste/ / 'dzin pa'i 'chang ni 'a yis 'phul/ / thur du phyung ba pha phyung yin/ / yu mar ja ni ja rkyang ste/ / ba bya mkha' la 'phur ba'i bya/ / ma mgo yan lag dam pa ste/ / la 'go nad dang skyon la sogs/ /

ma mgul mgrin pa'i zhe sa ste/ / 'a 'gul g.yo ba'i bye brag rnams/ / da drin phan pa'i bskyangs pa ste// ba brin nyo tshong skyen pa'i ming*/ / ga grags phyogs bcur khyab pa ste/ / da drags tshar gcod thal bar ro/ / das 'phul dngul ni rin chen te/ / ra rngul lus kyi drod rlangs chu/ / sngon po'i sngon ni sa sngon te/ / mas 'phul mngon ni mig gis mthong*/ / ra rngon ri dwags gsod pa'o/ / nges pa sgro 'dogs chod pa ste/ / nyes pa ma legs pa yi ming*/ / dben pa dgon pa'i stong pa nyid/ / dbyen ni mthun pa 'byed pa'o/ / sa snyed mang po'i sgra yin te/ / ra rnyed gsar du rnyed pa'o/ / ba blo sems dang sems 'byung ste/ / ga glo lus kyi bye brag yin/ / ra rtogs dang ni ga gtogs gnyis/ / go dang khongs su gtogs pa'o/ / la ltogs bkres pa'i ming yin no/ / ga gnon 'og tu 'dzud pa ste/ / sa snon mang du btang ba'o/ / ra rno mtshon rtse lta bu ste/ / ma mno bsam pa'i gzhig ma gtong*/ / da dpyi lus kyi bye brag ste/ / sa spyi thun mongs pa la 'jug / ga gnyug rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ / sa snyug shing gi bye brag go / ga gsod srog ni gcod pa ste/ / ba bsod zhing gi bsod nams so/ / gnyid du mnal ba mas 'phul te/ / snam bu'i snal ma sa btags so/ / rnal 'byor pa ni ra rna yin/ / 'od gsal ba ni ga gsal yin/ / skyon bsal ba ni ba bsal te/ / ga gran ran pa la sogs te/ / da dran sngar byas sems la shar/ / ba bran zhes bya g.yog gi ming*/ / nus pa rtug pa ra rtug ste/ / phub pa'i gdugs ni ga gdugs so/ / gzhan la rdeg pa ra rdeg te/ khang pa'i gdung ni ga gdung yin/ / log 'dren bdud ni bas 'phul te/ / dbang du sdud pa sa sdud yin/ / bzang ngan nyam pa mas 'phul te/ / yin nam snyam pa sa snyam yin/ / gnod pa'i gtse ba ga gtse ste/ / rtse mo rtse ba ra rtse yin/ / ba 'og ra brtse snying brtse'o/ / sa ster gzhan la ster ba'o/ / ga gter mi 'dzad pa yi mdzod/

/ sa smag mun rum 'thibs pa ste/ / da dmag go cha dmag dpung bcas/ / da drag stobs dang rtsal yin te/ / ga grag rna ba'i yul gyi sgra/ / ba brag ri rdo'i bye brag yin// sa stag gcan gzan khra bo ste/ / ra rtag nam yang mi 'gyur ba/ / ba btags phye mar 'thag pa ste/ / ba 'og ra brtag brtag dpyad do/ / bya ba mnga' ba mas 'phul te/ / skrag pa'i dngang pa das 'phul lo/ / sngags bzlas pa la ba btags so/ / ba bshol bya ba 'jog pa ste/ / ga gshol yul lugs thong ba'i gshol/ / dus kyi snga phyi ga gzod de/ / bzod sran che ba ba bzod yin/ / rlan gyi 'drul ba da 'drul te/ / lam gyi 'grul pa ga 'grul lo/ / thur du zab pa ga gting ste/ / rjes ma'am rkang rting ra rting yin/ / ba brting gdan ma la sogs te/ / ba btong bzhags pa la sogs te/ / ga gtong sbyin pa gtong ba yin/ / sa stong med pa'i stong pa'o/ / dum bur gsil ba gas 'phul te/ / grang ba'i bsil ba bas 'phul lo/ / zhe sa'i mdzad ni mas 'phul te/ / zad pa'i 'dzad ni 'as 'phul lo/ / sa snang mngon sum snang ba ste/ / ga gnang gzhan la ster ba'o/ / ra rnam rnam pa'i grangs yin te/ / dri ma mnam pa mas 'phul yin/ / ga gnam nam mkha' sngon po ste/ / sa snam zhes bya gos kyi rgyu/ / sa snying nang gi don snying ste/ / ra rnying rgas nas zad pa'o/ / ga gla las kyi rngan pa ste/ / ba bla bla med bla ma'o/ / sa sla chu mang tshegs med de/ / ba 'og brla ni lus kyi cha/ / ra rnams ba 'og sa bsnams ni/ / grangs dang phyag na bsnams pa'o/ / sa btags ste'u ra btags rte'u/ / gcod pa'i gri dang rta yi bu/ / ga gra da dra ba bra ma// snye rtse ya rabs tsher ma can/ / ga gral da dral ba bral rnams/ / sgrig pa ral pa gyes pa'o/ / ga grwa da dra ba bra rnams/ / tshogs pa gos bzo sems stor ro/ / ga gred da dred ba bred rnams/ / 'gyel ba dud 'gro byed pa'o/ / ga grod da drod ba brod rnams/ / zas snod tsha ba blo brod do/ / ga gri da dri ba bri rnams

/ mtshon dang sna yul zad pa'o/ / ga grangs da drangs rim bzhin du/ / gcig gnyis gsum dang zas sbyin pa'o/ / ga grogs da drogs rim bzhin du/ / lam mthun skrag nas bros pa'o/ / ra rtsal sa stsal ba sa'i bstsal/ / stobs dang bka' stsal bstsal tu gsol/ / ra rgyu sa sgyu rkyen zla dang*/ / skyes bu g.yo sgyu cha can nyid/ / ra rgyu ma dang sa sgyu ma/ / nang grol dang ni mi bden dper/ / sa skyen ra rkyen myur ba dang*/ / rgyu zla mya ngan byung la'ang 'jug / sa sku lus kyi zhe sa ste/ / ra rku ma byin len gyi ming*/ / da dku lus kyi byai brag yin/ / sa skar skar ma da dkar mdog/ ba bkar logs su bkar ba'o/ / sa sman 'tsho byed da dman ngan/ / ga gsung zhe sa ba bsung dri/ / ga gro 'bru yin da dro drod/ / ba bro rol mo ro bro ba/ / ga grang reg bya da drang srong*/ / ba brang lus kyi mdun phyogs yin/ / ra rtsang gnod byed ga gtsang chu/ / ga gzhon na tshod ba bzhon rta/ / ra rlung g.yo ba ka klung chu/ / ka klog gsung sgrog ga glog 'gyu/ / ga gla ri dwags sa sla myur/ / ba bris yi ge da dris gtam/ / sa skrag 'jigs pa ba bkrag 'od/ / da dpa' brtul phod sa spa mdzes/ / tshig phrad pa rnams rkyang pa yin/ / ba btson khrims mun bcug pa ste/ ba 'og ra brtson dge la spro/ / tshon rtsi la ni 'phul med de/ / gri mtshon rtags mtshon mas 'phul lo/ / mchod pa'i rten ni ra rten yin/ / sa 'og sa bsten bla ma'o/ / rigs 'dra sbyor ba ga 'gre ste/ / gnod byed 'dre ni da 'dre yin/ / zla bo'i grogs ni ga grogs te/ khur ba'i drogs mi da drogs yin/ / nad kyi rnag ni ra rnag ste/ kha dog gnag pa ga gnag yin/ / zas kyi rnangs pa ra rnangs te/ / dus kyi gnangs ni ga gnangs yin/ / lus kyi rngo ni ra rngo yin/ kha dog sngo ba sa sngo yin/ / ba 'og sa bsngo dge ba'o/ / sa rdo'i rdo ni ra rdo yin/ / ba bdo dar la bab pa yin/ / da dkor dkon mchog rdzas yin te/

/ ba 'og sa bskor 'khor gyis yod/ / nor 'jal 'a yis ja 'phul te/ / rten mjal ma yis ja 'phul lo/ / chu la rgal ba ra rgal te/ / zas kyi skal ba sa skal lo/ / ngo mtshar rmad byung ra rmad de/ / stod smad smad ni sa smad do/ / ka klu gnod pa'i sa bdag ste/ / ga glu snyan pa'i dbyangs brjod do/ / ba blu rin gyis nyo ba ste/ / sa slu gzhan gyis bslus pa'o/ / pra phab pa la ra btags te/ / bas 'phul gzhan yang de la sogs/ / brtags na nor ba mi srid pas/ / 'khrul bar 'byung ba mi srid kyang*/ / 'dra'o snyam nas nor bar bris/ / klog mkhan rnams kyis nor bar klog / rtog dpyod mkhan pos log par go / de nas don rnams 'phyug pa srid/ / de phyir 'khrul ba bsal bya'i phyir/ / nyer mkho'i bstan bcos 'di nyid kyis/ / dbye ba so sor bshad pa 'di/ / ma 'dres so sor shes par bya/ / de ni 'dir dmigs bsal gyi sgo nas 'dra'o snyam pa rnams mi 'dra bar so sor dbye ba'o/ / 'di ni sngon gyi sgra bsgyur rnams/ / sbyor tshul mthun pa'i brda la ni/ / cung zad phal cher ma mthun na'ang*/ / phal cher gsar bcad dbang du byas/ / 'di ni mkhas rmongs 'byed pa ste/ / don 'di khong du chud pa'i mis/ / mang po 'dus pa'i dkyil dag tu/ / mkhas pa'i gdan la 'dug par dbang*/ / de slad blo gros gsal rnams kyi/ / dri med gzhung lugs 'di nyid la/ / rnam dpyod blo gros goms pa yis/ / tshig gis sdeb sbyor legs par byas/ / dag yig nye mkho bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ shākya'i dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'o// / / sarba maṅga laṃ/ / gcig zhus so/ / / / bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ rngog blo ldan shes rab kyi gsung chos skor/ dag yig nye 'kho bsdus pa shākya'i dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so/ / -PAGE 670--PAGE 669--PAGE 662-
